phases.title: Wire up the extension
phases.description: Open the workspace in Cursor, install the extension, and confirm the PlanStack sidebar shows this plan.

tasks.desc: Open the HackUPC repo in Cursor.
Run `npm install && npm run compile` inside extension/.
Press F5 to launch the Extension Development Host.

phases.title: Run a phase
phases.description: Use the sidebar to run this phase via the configured execution mode.

tasks.desc: Set planstack.cursor.executionMode in settings (native-first, cli, sdk-local, sdk-cloud).
Click Run on this phase from the sidebar.
